title: Replace EdgeInsets.only(left:/right:) with EdgeInsetsDirectional in ParentTrackManagementScreen
why: AX-1 bans `EdgeInsets.only(left:/right:)` outright because this app is RTL (Hebrew). The values here are symmetric (16/16) so there's no visible bug today, but it's exactly the banned pattern and a latent trap: if a future edit makes left/right asymmetric without switching to Directional, it silently breaks in Hebrew. The digest notes the AX-1 grep 'exists only in ROOT Makefile audit' — this violation surviving in a batch where `make audit` passed suggests that grep doesn't actually scan learning_tracker/lib/** for this pattern, a real coverage gap in an [E]nforced rule.
recommendation: Replace with EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 16, end: 16, top: 8, bottom: 96), and verify/extend the AX-1 grep so it actually scans learning_tracker/lib/**.
acceptance_criteria: Line uses EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start:/end:) instead of left:/right:
make audit's AX-1 grep is confirmed to scan learning_tracker/lib/** and would have caught this

corrections: Acceptance criterion asking to 'verify/extend the AX-1 grep' duplicates novelty-filter known-gap #7 (RTL grep only in root Makefile) — trim that criterion; the underlying line-120 violation instance itself is still novel and stands.
